data.action: 手扶船舷侧身回眸，毛毯拢于肩头迎风伫立
data.camera: low angle, looking back, medium shot, 侧后仰视中景，船舷与夜海背景
data.description: 夜航中破浪前行的甲板船舷旁，刺骨的夜风吹动深海风衣的衣角与及膝银发。察觉到身后走近的脚步，斯卡蒂微微侧身回眸，将肩上的毛毯稍稍拢紧，眼神中浮现出一丝难得的温和。
data.lighting: 甲板暗黄壁灯与冷色夜空月辉交织
data.location: 罗德岛舰船外甲板船舷
data.promptProse: Standing by the ship's outer railing against the open midnight ocean, Skadi draws a dark blanket closely over her shoulders. The biting sea breeze catches her silver hair as she turns to look back over her shoulder with serene crimson eyes under the amber glow of deck lanterns.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 夜航甲板的披风回眸
data.animaCaption: Holding the blanket around her shoulders against the night wind, she looks back over her shoulder beside the ship railing under the warm lantern light.
